correctness.rationale: The equation 6t=4t+2(n_0+n_3) forces exactly t universal source-or-sink cone vertices on each directed triangle. Explicit transitive two-path boundaries of length <=3 fill every triangular cycle. A rooted triangular basis is integral/unimodular, so all integral one-cycles, not merely rational ones, bound. For order 3, the three forbidden shortcuts are linearly independent and Omega_2 is zero. Stdlib verifier exhaustively confirms Paley sizes 7,11,19,23,31 and separately implemented GLMY mod-prime rank calculations for Paley7/11 and cyclic7. This is a general proof, not a finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Full foundational texts arxiv:1207.2834 and arxiv:1407.0234 introduce regular path homology, triangles and digraph homotopy but no specified doubly regular tournament first-homology vanishing or quantitative integral fillers. The closest public index result computes nonzero path H1 of cyclic regular tournaments; related Paley results concern a different directed-flag chain complex. A first-homology cycle space theorem arxiv:1710.01264 treats undirected/bidirected graphs and field coefficients, so its abstract coverage does not imply this one-way orientation, integral theorem. Equivalence and unindexed-source risks remain, but the actually accessible sources showed no dominating coverage.
residual_risks: Unindexed equivalent literature or inaccessible full repository papers might contain an unexpected stronger tournament result; no blanket uniqueness claim is made.

This is an infinite structurally motivated topology result, not a restatement of a small example or a rational rank computation.
